title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: notice windows after delivery and the claim time bar
content:
## Scope

This part of the notice and time bar policy of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line fixes the time limits for notice of loss after delivery and the time bar after which no claim is admissible. Every limit is counted from the cover's recorded delivery date and compared with the notice date on the claim file, both system records.

## Policy clause

1. Written notice of loss not apparent at delivery must reach the line no later than the tier's notice period for such loss, in calendar days after the cargo was delivered. The notice window ends on the cover's delivery date plus the tier's notice days, counted on calendar dates, and a notice whose notice date is that last day is in time.
2. Loss apparent at delivery must be noted on the delivery receipt where the tier's notice period for apparent loss is 0; otherwise it must be notified within that many calendar days of delivery.
3. Notice of delay loss must reach the line within the tier's delay loss notice period, in calendar days of delivery.
4. No claim is admissible after the tier's claim time bar, in calendar months after the cargo was delivered. The time bar falls on the same calendar day of the month that many months after the delivery date, or on the last day of that month when it has no such day, and a notice dated on the time bar day is in time.
5. Notices out of time are rejected with the reason notice out of time or claim time-barred.

## Boundary cases: notice window (hypothetical window of 10 calendar days)

| Delivery date | Last day of window | Notice date | Judgement |
|---|---|---|---|
| 25 January | 4 February | 4 February | In time |
| 25 January | 4 February | 3 February | In time |
| 25 January | 4 February | 5 February | Out of time |

## Boundary cases: time bar (hypothetical time bar of 6 calendar months)

| Delivery date | Time bar day | Notice date | Judgement |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 March 2025 | 15 September 2025 | 15 September 2025 | In time |
| 15 March 2025 | 15 September 2025 | 16 September 2025 | Time-barred |
| 31 August 2025 | 28 February 2026 (February has no 31st) | 28 February 2026 | In time |
| 31 August 2025 | 28 February 2026 | 1 March 2026 | Time-barred |

## Wrong reading and correct basis

- *Wrong reading:* the window runs for full 24-hour periods from the hour of delivery. *Correct basis:* it is counted on calendar dates from the delivery date, and the last day itself is in time.
- *Wrong reading:* a time bar from 31 August runs to 31 February, and so into March. *Correct basis:* when the month has no such day, the time bar falls on that month's last day.
